title: Felt Hammer v2
description: A melancholy felt-piano piece that now breathes and builds: a hushed chordal intro gives way to a rolling left-hand arpeggio, brushed 707 percussion, and a low sub that swells into a fuller, more urgent middle before stripping back to a quiet outro. Faster and more restless than the original sketch while keeping the soft, intimate piano at its heart.
